relations.evidence: gaurīśaṃkara śarmmaṇā || māhātmyaṃ mārggamāsasyā, lekhaccutasubhaktinā || || thvana saṃti vaiśākhī pūrṇṇimā, thvakunhu, puṭhisoka, vatāyā śrī bhavānī śaṃkaraṇa

date.as_written: same asminsoma vedebhe, rādhemāse, vidhauyute | śambhostithau dine paṃgo

notes: The chronogram 'soma-vedebhe' indicates NS 841 (soma = 1, veda = 4, ibha = 8). Paṅgu refers to Śanivāra (Saturday). The text mentions subsequent festivities and feeding on Vaiśākhī Pūrṇimā organized by Bhavānīśaṃkara.
